Wider setting — Arcanum Inner Sanctum: The inner walled precinct of the Arcanum within Vaelmark — restricted to enrolled mages, faculty, and authorized Pillar visits. Contains the most sensitive magical research facilities in the kingdom.

Wider setting — Greenveil: The living city. Grown rather than built — architecture integrated with ancient trees. The Ironmane breeding fields are three hours' ride east. Greenveil is the oldest continuously settled territory now under Starhaven's banner.
Composition: An open-air workshop under enormous trees.
Details to include: wood-carvers of many races working fallen logs into doors, memorial boards with carved names (no readable text) and toy animals, shavings on the ground, a carver listening with her hand on a root, a child holding a toy wolf.

What it is: The ancestral iron Gada of Rudra Vanar, driven into the earth before Starhold’s gates — the Vanari alliance’s only seal. No treaty was ever signed; this is the promise. Children touch it for luck.
Composition: A view from the road outside the great stone gates of Starhold, the Gada standing in a small patch of untouched grass in the midground, the gates and walls rising behind it.

Environment: the heart of the kingdom — green river country, broad rivers and tree-lined avenues, iron lanterns, well-kept roads, soft temperate light.
Architecture: Starhaven's established look, matching the other images of the kingdom — a dark, grand high-fantasy stone city: weathered grey and charcoal stone, soaring towers and slender spires, pointed and round arches, grand domed halls, clock towers, steep dark slate roofs, wrought-iron lanterns, heavy carved detail, mist between the buildings and mountains on the horizon.
